val trapVec = io.commits.commitValid.zip(deqPtrVec).map { case (v, d) =>
      io.commits.isCommit && v && dt_isXSTrap(d.value)
    }
    val hitTrap = trapVec.reduce(_ || _)
    val difftest = DifftestModule(new DiffTrapEvent, dontCare = true)
    difftest.coreid := io.hartId
    difftest.hasTrap := hitTrap
    difftest.cycleCnt := timer
    difftest.instrCnt := instrCnt
    difftest.hasWFI := hasWFI

    if (env.EnableDifftest) {
      val trapCode = PriorityMux(wdata.zip(trapVec).map(x => x._2 -> x._1))
      val trapPC = SignExt(PriorityMux(wpc.zip(trapVec).map(x => x._2 -> x._1)), XLEN)
      difftest.code := trapCode
      difftest.pc := trapPC
    }

#define PROXY_COMPARE_AND_DISPLAY(field, field_names)                     \
  do {                                                                    \
    uint64_t *_ptr_dut = (uint64_t *)(&((dut)->field));                   \
    uint64_t *_ptr_ref = (uint64_t *)(&(field));                          \
    for (int i = 0; i < sizeof(field) / sizeof(uint64_t); i++) {          \
      if (_ptr_dut[i] != _ptr_ref[i]) {                                   \
        Info(                                                             \
            "%7s different at pc = 0x%010lx, right= 0x%016lx, "           \
            "wrong = 0x%016lx\n",                                         \
            field_names[i], dut->commit[0].pc, _ptr_ref[i], _ptr_dut[i]); \
      }                                                                   \

conclusions: Injection and mismatch bind the same fault PC and vector register; their high64 XOR is exactly 1<<36 (full vector bit100).
The sole ABORT line immediately follows the sole mismatch line in the same raw stdout stream.
display_trapinfo reads dut->trap.pc; RTL supplies the PC selected by trapVec for XSTrap. A DiffTest STATE_ABORT is not an XSTrap guarantee.
The ABORT event PC must be recorded separately; it is not required to equal the injection/mismatch fault PC and must not be hard-coded.
For this run fault_pc=0x80001bdc and abort_event_pc=0x800016b0. Their inequality is consistent with the separate source semantics.
run.log is derived by concatenating all stderr bytes then all stdout bytes. Text position of the injection before mismatch in that derived log is not evidence of real cross-stream global chronology.
The strict gate can bind unique injection/mismatch markers, PC, register and exact bit difference, and check mismatch-to-ABORT order in raw stdout; cross-stream time must not be inferred.
This review does not itself validate the forthcoming gate or declare the full O1 suite passed.
